name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: If either $10 goes with Cobalt or Dane does not go with Espresso (but not both), then Cobalt goes with Latte.
$6 goes with none of Edith, Espresso, or Amber.
Between $4 and $8, one goes with Chai and the other with Jade.
Either Latte goes with $6 or Edith goes with Amber.
The Latte order's price is higher than both Cara and the order in the Amber mug.
Between Cara and Dane, one goes with Latte and the other with Mocha.
Either Edith goes with $6 or Jade goes with Dane.
